mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mock_price (profile_code, prod_code, prod_name, prod_type, ex_code, market_type, current_price) VALUES (#{profileCode}, #{prodCode}, #{prodName}, #{prodType}, #{exCode}, #{marketType}, #{currentPrice})
mapper.select: SELECT profile_code, prod_code, prod_name, prod_type, ex_code, market_type, current_price FROM mock_price WHERE profile_code = #{profileCode} ORDER BY prod_code ASC
SELECT profile_code, prod_code, prod_name, prod_type, ex_code, market_type, current_price FROM mock_price WHERE profile_code = #{profileCode} AND prod_code = #{prodCode}
mapper.update: UPDATE mock_price SET current_price = #{currentPrice} WHERE profile_code = #{profileCode} AND prod_code = #{prodCode}
